theme: 3 terms on enums: modeling choices in Swift

terms.definition: A type that lists a fixed set of related choices, called cases.
terms.example: Use an enum for the order status, and the compiler checks every case.

terms.definition: Extra data stored inside one case of an enum, so each case can carry its own details.
terms.example: Add an associated value to the card case, so it keeps the last four digits.

terms.definition: A fixed number or text that each enum case is created with, such as 1 or "low".
terms.example: Give each level a raw value, so we can save it as a number.

video.title: Enum, Associated Value & Raw Value in 2 minutes | iOS Daily English Day 7
video.description:
Learn to talk about enums in Swift: Enum, Associated Value and Raw Value, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Enum - A type that lists a fixed set of related choices, called cases.
Associated Value - Extra data stored inside one case of an enum, so each case can carry its own details.
Raw Value - A fixed number or text that each enum case is created with, such as 1 or "low".

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

Explain Enum, Associated Value and Raw Value in Swift by listening to a real status-screen chat between two iOS devs.
열거형, 연관 값, 원시 값 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Enum - A type that lists a fixed set of related choices, called cases.
한국어: 정해진 선택지(케이스)를 모아 둔 타입

Associated Value - Extra data stored inside one case of an enum, so each case can carry its own details.
한국어: 열거형 케이스 안에 함께 저장하는 추가 데이터

dialogue.title: Building the order status screen

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I keep making typos in our order status strings.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Try an enum. It lists every status as a case, so typos are impossible.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Nice. But the server sends 1 and 2, not words.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Then give each case a raw value. In `Status`, `paid` is 1 and `shipped` is 2.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Great. Can `shipped` also keep a tracking number?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes, add an associated value. In `Step`, `shipped(tracking: String)` carries it.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then I will put an associated value in `Status` too.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Careful. An enum with a raw value cannot have an associated value.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Oh, my mistake. So I need two enums.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Right. `Status` uses a raw value for the server, and `Step` uses an associated value for the screen.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Perfect, that makes sense. Thanks, Mina!
